messages:
Tom H: quick q — should deploy-bot auto-bump a patch for infra-only changes during release-hotfix window? yesterday a patch went out and caused an unexpected rollback for a downstream customer.
Sasha L: my instinct = no. hotfix window should be for customer-impacting fixes only.
Maya R: agreed. need a clear def for infra-only vs public-surface change. small infra tweaks should not trigger release-tag bumps automatically.
Ops-Jen: FWIW the rollback was because buildmeta changed and our edge cache invalidated. customers saw 500s for a minute.
Tom H: right — so the bot bumped patch b/c of labels, but the change was side-effect-y. how do folks feel about label-only heuristics?
Sasha L: label-only is too blunt. we should consider files touched + semantic keywords. e.g., changes under /infra/ or ci/ => skip auto-bump unless accompanied by "semver:patch" or similar.
Maya R: proposal:
```
deploy-bot heuristics v0.2:
- auto-bump patch if PR has label: semver:patch OR contains CHANGELOG entry
- skip auto-bump for PRs that only touch: /infra/, /ci/, /docs/, /scripts/
- deps-only PRs: auto-bump patch only if dependency is runtime (not dev) and tests pass
- during hotfix window: require explicit `semver:patch` label or manual +1 from release lead
```
Ops-Jen: love the hotfix extra guard. prevents noisy tagging at night. :sleepy:
deploy-bot: auto-bump attempt at 1708501250 matched labels [infra, ci]; bump type: patch; action: tagged v1.12.5; reason: label-match
Maya R: ^this is exactly the problem. infra label caused a tag even though no public change. can we add file-path exceptions?
Sasha L: yes — bot should inspect changed files first. if only infra/ci/docs/scripts => annotate PR and do NOT bump.
Tom H: ok — action items: (1) implement file-path exclusion in deploy-bot, (2) add hotfix-window override to require `semver:patch`, (3) post-release note for yesterday's rollback and mark as non-user-impacting.
Ops-Jen: i can take deploy-bot change. will open PR with tests for path matching and add an opt-in config in repo: `.deploybot/config.yaml`
Maya R: can you add a metric alert when bot tags during hotfix window so release lead gets pinged? we want one extra human check.
Ops-Jen: yeah will add `notify: #release-oncall` for hotfix tags.
Sasha L: sounds good. also update the release docs: add a short table of what counts as infra-only vs public API.
Tom H: thanks everyone. i’ll draft a small changelog entry and ping release lead for follow-up.
Maya R: :thumbsup:
